outboundAuthorization.title: Outbound authorization
outboundAuthorization.description: Who an unattended run may message or email without asking. Shadow mode only observes.
outboundAuthorization.remoteHost: This device is driving a paired Host, where the runs and their records are. Change this setting on the Host.

enforce.label: Enforce outbound authorization
enforce.shadowHelp: Off: every send is checked and recorded, and none is changed. Turn on to hold the sends nothing authorized.
enforce.enforceHelp: On: an unattended send to a recipient nobody allowed is drafted or waits for approval, and a recipient a person refused stays refused for that request.

report.title: What enforcement would change
report.description: Sends observed in the last {days} days whose recipient nothing allowed. Allow the ones you meant before turning enforcement on.
report.empty: Nothing would change: every observed send had a recipient someone allowed.

outboundAuthorization.noList: No list can hold this recipient

confirm.title: Enforce outbound authorization?
confirm.behaviour: Unattended sends to a recipient nobody allowed will be drafted or wait for approval instead of going out, and a person's refusal holds for the rest of that request.
confirm.impact: {count, plural, one {# observed send} other {# observed sends}} would have been changed:
confirm.noImpact: No observed send would have been changed.
